    Controlled embeddings and Theorem 5.1 #

    A controlled embedding of D_fin into mod A is the input of Theorem 2.7: a faithful k-linear representation embedding Φ : D_fin → mod A with finite-dimensional values and retractions on C_fin whose kernels satisfy a common nilpotence bound. Controlled embeddings transport along fully faithful exact functors that preserve finite dimension (inflation and Morita equivalence, Lemma 3.1), and a controlled embedding yields the representation embedding of Theorem A (Theorem 5.1).
